item.text:
{
  "page_id": "astral-sh/uv/README.md",
  "source_sha256": "57a84a5a635f30e3a26541ebc16ca690944a7750f05713b1af92d3170b58f704",
  "units": [
    {"ordinal":0,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Page title."},
    {"ordinal":1,"function":"definition","proposition":"uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust.","support":"Projects and pip interface examples; speed claim links to BENCHMARKS.md in Highlights. Rust implementation evidence is absent."},
    {"ordinal":2,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Highlights heading."},
    {"ordinal":3,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv replaces multiple tools with a single tool.","support":"Protected list names pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, twine, and virtualenv; subsequent feature sections describe corresponding operations."},
    {"ordinal":4,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv replaces additional unspecified tools.","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":5,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv is 10-100x faster than pip.","support":"https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/main/BENCHMARKS.md; nearby chart caption specifies installing Trio dependencies with a warm cache."},
    {"ordinal":6,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv provides comprehensive project management with a universal lockfile.","support":"#projects examples; https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/layout#the-lockfile."},
    {"ordinal":7,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv runs scripts with inline dependency metadata.","support":"#scripts shows adding metadata and running example.py; https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/scripts#declaring-script-dependencies."},
    {"ordinal":8,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv installs and manages Python versions.","support":"#python-versions demonstrates installation, version selection, and pinning."},
    {"ordinal":9,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv runs and installs tools published as Python packages.","support":"#tools demonstrates running pycowsay and installing ruff."},
    {"ordinal":10,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv offers a pip-compatible interface with a familiar CLI and improved performance.","support":"#the-pip-interface limits replacement to common commands and gives compile and sync examples; Highlights links BENCHMARKS.md."},
    {"ordinal":11,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv supports Cargo-style workspaces for scalable projects.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/workspaces; no scaling measurements supplied."},
    {"ordinal":12,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv saves disk space through global-cache dependency deduplication.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/cache; no disk-space measurements supplied."},
    {"ordinal":13,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv is installable without Rust or Python via curl or pip.","support":"Installation section provides standalone and pip commands; prerequisite-free use of both routes is unclear."},
    {"ordinal":14,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Connects protected installation alternatives curl and pip."},
    {"ordinal":15,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.","support":"Installation examples label these platforms; FAQ links https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/platforms/."},
    {"ordinal":16,"function":"other","proposition":"Astral backs uv and created Ruff and ty.","support":"Links to https://astral.sh, https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff, and https://github.com/astral-sh/ty; no further substantiation supplied."},
    {"ordinal":17,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Installation heading."},
    {"ordinal":18,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Install uv using its standalone installers.","support":"Following shell and PowerShell examples use https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh and https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1."},
    {"ordinal":19,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Alternatively, install uv from PyPI.","support":"https://pypi.org/project/uv/ and following pip install uv and pipx install uv examples."},
    {"ordinal":20,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv can update itself to the latest version if installed through the standalone installer.","support":"Following uv self update example; explicitly conditional on standalone installation."},
    {"ordinal":21,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the installation documentation for details and alternative methods.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/."},
    {"ordinal":22,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Documentation heading."},
    {"ordinal":23,"function":"other","proposition":"uv documentation is available at docs.astral.sh/uv.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv."},
    {"ordinal":24,"function":"capability","proposition":"Command-line reference documentation is accessible with uv help.","support":"Protected inline command uv help; no output example supplied."},
    {"ordinal":25,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Features heading."},
    {"ordinal":26,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Projects heading."},
    {"ordinal":27,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv manages project dependencies and environments, supporting lockfiles, workspaces, and more, similarly to rye or poetry.","support":"Following uv init, uv add, uv run, uv lock, and uv sync examples; Highlights links workspace documentation."},
    {"ordinal":28,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Connects protected comparison targets rye and poetry."},
    {"ordinal":29,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the project documentation to get started.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/projects/."},
    {"ordinal":30,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv builds and publishes projects even when they are not managed with uv.","support":"Adjacent publish guide link: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/publish/."},
    {"ordinal":31,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the publish guide for more information.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/publish/."},
    {"ordinal":32,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Scripts heading."},
    {"ordinal":33,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv manages dependencies and environments for single-file scripts.","support":"Following examples add requests metadata to example.py and run it with uv run."},
    {"ordinal":34,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Create a script and add inline dependency metadata.","support":"Following example creates example.py and invokes uv add --script example.py requests."},
    {"ordinal":35,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Run the script in an isolated virtual environment.","support":"Following uv run example.py output reads inline metadata and installs five packages; isolation is stated in prose."},
    {"ordinal":36,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the scripts documentation to get started.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/scripts/."},
    {"ordinal":37,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Tools heading."},
    {"ordinal":38,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv executes and installs command-line tools from Python packages, similarly to pipx.","support":"Following uvx pycowsay and uv tool install ruff examples."},
    {"ordinal":39,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Use uvx to run a tool in an ephemeral environment.","support":"Protected uvx command and following pycowsay example; environment lifetime is stated in prose."},
    {"ordinal":40,"function":"definition","proposition":"uvx is an alias for uv tool run.","support":"Parenthetical connects the protected identifiers uvx and uv tool run."},
    {"ordinal":41,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Install a tool with uv tool install.","support":"Following uv tool install ruff example installs an executable and checks its version."},
    {"ordinal":42,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the tools documentation to get started.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/tools/."},
    {"ordinal":43,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Python versions heading."},
    {"ordinal":44,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv installs Python and enables quick switching between versions.","support":"Following installation, --python selection, and uv python pin examples; switching speed is not measured."},
    {"ordinal":45,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Install multiple Python versions.","support":"uv python install 3.12 3.13 3.14 example reports three installed versions."},
    {"ordinal":46,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Download Python versions as needed.","support":"Following examples select Python 3.12.0 with uv venv and pypy@3.8 with uv run."},
    {"ordinal":47,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Select a specific Python version for the current directory.","support":"uv python pin 3.11 example reports pinning .python-version to 3.11."},
    {"ordinal":48,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the Python installation documentation to get started.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/install-python/."},
    {"ordinal":49,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"The pip interface heading."},
    {"ordinal":50,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv provides a drop-in replacement for common pip, pip-tools, and virtualenv commands.","support":"Explicitly limited to common commands; following compile, venv, and sync examples."},
    {"ordinal":51,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Connects protected tool names in the replacement claim."},
    {"ordinal":52,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Completes the replacement claim's noun phrase."},
    {"ordinal":53,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv extends those interfaces with dependency version overrides, platform-independent and reproducible resolutions, alternative resolution strategies, and more.","support":"Following uv pip compile --universal example illustrates platform-independent resolution; other features lack examples here."},
    {"ordinal":54,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Migrating to the uv pip interface preserves existing workflows and yields a 10-100x speedup.","support":"Preceding replacement claim is limited to common commands; Highlights links BENCHMARKS.md and chart caption specifies Trio dependencies with a warm cache."},
    {"ordinal":55,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Completes the preceding uv pip interface phrase."},
    {"ordinal":56,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Compile requirements into a platform-independent requirements file.","support":"Following uv pip compile requirements.in --universal --output-file requirements.txt example."},
    {"ordinal":57,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Create a virtual environment.","support":"Following uv venv example creates .venv using Python 3.12.3."},
    {"ordinal":58,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Install the locked requirements.","support":"Following uv pip sync requirements.txt example reports installing 43 packages."},
    {"ordinal":59,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the pip interface documentation to get started.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/pip/index/."},
    {"ordinal":60,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Contributing heading."},
    {"ordinal":61,"function":"promotion","proposition":"The maintainers welcome participation and express commitment to supporting contributors at every experience level.","support":"Adjacent contributing guide link; concrete support practices are absent."},
    {"ordinal":62,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the contributing guide to get started.","support":"https://github.com/astral-sh/uv?tab=contributing-ov-file#contributing."},
    {"ordinal":63,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"FAQ heading."},
    {"ordinal":64,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Question introducing pronunciation guidance."},
    {"ordinal":65,"function":"definition","proposition":"uv is pronounced \"you - vee\".","support":"Protected IPA /juː viː/ links to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA/English#Key."},
    {"ordinal":66,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Question introducing styling guidance."},
    {"ordinal":67,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Style the name as \"uv\".","support":"Adjacent style guide link: ./STYLE.md#styling-uv."},
    {"ordinal":68,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult the style guide for details.","support":"./STYLE.md#styling-uv."},
    {"ordinal":69,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Question introducing platform support guidance."},
    {"ordinal":70,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult uv's platform support document.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/platforms/."},
    {"ordinal":71,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Question introducing production-readiness claims."},
    {"ordinal":72,"function":"capability","proposition":"uv is production-ready, stable, and widely used in production.","support":"Adjacent versioning policy link: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/versioning/; production adoption evidence is absent."},
    {"ordinal":73,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult uv's versioning policy for details.","support":"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/versioning/."},
    {"ordinal":74,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Acknowledgments heading."},
    {"ordinal":75,"function":"other","proposition":"uv's dependency resolver uses PubGrub.","support":"https://github.com/pubgrub-rs/pubgrub; implementation evidence is absent."},
    {"ordinal":76,"function":"other","proposition":"The authors thank PubGrub maintainers, especially Jacob Finkelman, for their support.","support":"Jacob Finkelman is linked at https://github.com/Eh2406; specific support is not described."},
    {"ordinal":77,"function":"other","proposition":"uv's Git implementation is based on Cargo.","support":"https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo; implementation comparison is absent."},
    {"ordinal":78,"function":"other","proposition":"Some uv optimizations were inspired by pnpm, Orogene, and Bun.","support":"Links to https://pnpm.io/, https://github.com/orogene/orogene, and https://github.com/oven-sh/bun; specific optimizations are not identified."},
    {"ordinal":79,"function":"other","proposition":"The authors learned from Nathaniel J. Smith's Posy and adapted its trampoline for Windows support.","support":"https://github.com/njsmith/posy and https://github.com/njsmith/posy/tree/main/src/trampolines/windows-trampolines/posy-trampoline."},
    {"ordinal":80,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"License heading."},
    {"ordinal":81,"function":"qualification","proposition":"uv is available under either of the listed licenses.","support":"Following list specifies Apache License, Version 2.0, and MIT; closing phrase grants the user's choice."},
    {"ordinal":82,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Apache License, Version 2.0, is one licensing option.","support":"LICENSE-APACHE and https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0; surrounding prose says either license is available at the user's option."},
    {"ordinal":83,"function":"qualification","proposition":"The MIT license is one licensing option.","support":"LICENSE-MIT and https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT; surrounding prose says either license is available at the user's option."},
    {"ordinal":84,"function":"qualification","proposition":"The user may choose between the listed licenses.","support":"Preceding licensing statement and Apache-2.0/MIT list."},
    {"ordinal":85,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Unless explicitly stated otherwise, contributions intentionally submitted for inclusion in uv, as defined by Apache-2.0, are dual-licensed under the listed licenses without additional terms or conditions.","support":"Preceding Apache License, Version 2.0, and MIT license options; explicit exception for a contributor stating otherwise."}
  ]
}
